changes: Daybreak now follows the sky: sky blue in sunshine, blue-gray under clouds and gray in rain, across the app and widgets.
Clear nights show an approximate moon phase. Sunrise and sunset appear in the full and cover-screen forecasts and the detailed widget, with offline estimates when the source omits them.
Active frost, wind and thunderstorm alerts add subtle ice, wind and lightning edges to the app and every widget size. Expired alerts disappear on redraw; Open-Meteo does not supply official alerts.
